welcome_key_stays: Your key stays on your device.
username_rule: Only letters, numbers and underscores, {min} to {max} characters.
enrollment_opening_receiving: Opening your account and receiving your money…
enrollment_device_will_ask: Your device will ask for it now.
enrollment_choose_explanation: This is how people find you to send you money. Next you'll create a passkey to protect your account.
enrollment_is_it_yours: Is it yours? Sign in with your passkey
enrollment_account_on_device: There's already an account saved on this device.
enrollment_resigned: The request was updated. Confirm again with your passkey.
enrollment_lapsed: Your request expired. Choose your @username again.
enrollment_username_taken: @{username} is already taken. Choose another one.
enrollment_username_taken_meanwhile: @{username} was taken while we created your account. Choose another @username.
enrollment_interrupted: Your sign-up was interrupted. Choose your @username again.
enrollment_prf_unsupported: This device or browser doesn't support passkeys with PRF. Orchid needs a compatible passkey to create and protect your account.
enrollment_passkey_cancelled_confirm: You cancelled the confirmation. Your account isn't created yet.
enrollment_wrong_credential: You used a different passkey. Confirm with the one you just created.
enrollment_assertion_rejected: We couldn't verify your passkey. Confirm with your fingerprint, face or PIN.
enrollment_corrupt_envelope: We couldn't encrypt your key on this device. Start over.
enrollment_registration_refused: We couldn't register your passkey. Choose your @username again.
enrollment_link_mismatch: This link is incomplete. Open it again from the message you were sent.
enrollment_no_passkey_again: You don't need your passkey again.
enrollment_use_new_passkey: Use the passkey you just created to open your account.
enrollment_use_new_passkey_receive: Use the passkey you just created to open your account and receive {amount}.
opening_explanation: Your account isn't open on the Solana network yet. Confirm with your passkey to open it.
opening_device_failed: Something failed on this device. Your account is unchanged.
opening_unsupported: This device couldn't prepare the opening. Your account is unchanged.
opening_redrafted: The request changed. Review it and confirm again.
opening_pending_note: The Solana network is still confirming. Refresh in a few seconds.
opening_passkey_cancelled: You didn't use your passkey, so we didn't open your account.
opening_wrong_credential: You used a different passkey. Confirm with your account's passkey.
opening_assertion_rejected: We couldn't verify your passkey. Confirm with your device's fingerprint, face or PIN.
opening_prf_missing: Your passkey didn't unlock your key on this device. Your account is unchanged.
opening_corrupt: The data saved in this browser is damaged. Your account is unchanged.
opening_draft_rejected: We prepared a new one for you to review. Your account is unchanged.
opening_username_taken: Another account took that username before you opened yours.
opening_address_bound: Your username is already linked to this account.
opening_invalid_address: The key saved on this device isn't a valid account.
opening_no_wallet: This browser has no saved account.
session_description: We need to confirm it's you before continuing. You can use your fingerprint, face or device PIN.
session_passkey_cancelled: You didn't use your passkey. Try again.
session_wrong_credential: You used a different passkey. Try again with your account's passkey.
session_assertion_rejected: We couldn't verify your passkey. Confirm with your device's fingerprint, face or PIN and try again.
session_assertion_refused: Orchid couldn't verify your passkey. Try again.
session_challenge_refused: The confirmation took too long. Try again.
session_no_backup: This account has no backup passkey, so we can't confirm it's you.
session_no_wallet: This device has no Orchid account.
browser_outdated_ios_note: Orchid needs iOS 18.4 or later to protect your account with a passkey. Update from Settings, General, Software Update.
browser_embedded_reason: {app} opens links in its own browser, which can't use passkeys, and Orchid needs them to protect your account.
browser_embedded_storage: Your browser keeps its data apart from {app}: an account created inside {app} won't show up there, and if you already have a backed-up account you can restore it with your passkey.
browser_step_menu: Tap the ⋯ menu or the share icon in {app}.
browser_step_choose: Choose “Open in browser”, “Open in Safari” or “Open in Chrome”.
browser_step_paste: If it isn't there, copy the link and paste it into your browser's address bar.
browser_copy_failed: We couldn't copy it. Press and hold the link to copy it.
restore_explanation: Use the passkey you backed up your account with. Your @username and balance come back to this device.
restore_located: We found @{username}'s backup. Confirm with your passkey to save it on this device.
restore_backup_unsupported: This browser can't open your backup with that passkey.
restore_passkey_cancelled: You didn't use a passkey. Try again.
restore_no_backup: We couldn't find a backup for that passkey.
restore_assertion_refused: We couldn't verify that passkey. Try again.
restore_backup_mismatch: The backup doesn't match the account. We didn't save it.
restore_unverified: We couldn't check the copy on this device. Your backup is intact. Try again.
restore_corrupt_device: The data saved on this device is damaged. We didn't replace it.
